### Load Packages

```{r message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidytuesdayR)
library(skimr)
library(camcorder)
library(ggtext)
library(glue)
library(showtext)
source(file = "~/Documents/Code/R Studio/Utilities/fonts.R")
source(file = "~/Documents/Code/R Studio/Utilities/caption.R")
```

### Fonts and Colors

```{r}
primary <-  "#386641"
secondary <- "#bc4749"

font_add_google(name = "Nunito",family = "Nunito")
f1 <- "Nunito"


caption <- create_social_caption(tt_year = "2026",tt_week = "5",source_text = "Edible Plants Database",note_text = "Test")

setup_fonts()
```


### Load Data

```{r message=FALSE}

tt_data <- tt_load(2026, week=5)
edible_plants_raw <- tt_data$edible_plants

gg_record(dir = file.path("~/Documents/Code/R Studio/JG Website/Website/TidyTuesdayProjects/plots",
                          "2026","week5"),device = "png",width = 5,height = 7,dpi = 300,units = "in")
```

### Explore Data

```{r}

edible_plants_raw |> 
  skim()

```

### Tidy Data

```{r}

cleaned_data <- edible_plants_raw |>
  filter(!is.na(temperature_growing)) |> 
  filter(!is.na(temperature_germination)) |> 
  select(cultivation,temperature_growing,temperature_germination) |> 
  separate_wider_delim(temperature_growing,delim = "-",
                       names = c("min_temp_grow","max_temp_grow"),too_few = "align_start") |> 
  separate_wider_delim(temperature_germination,delim = "-",names = c("min_temp_germination","max_temp_germination"),too_few = "align_start") |> 
  mutate(max_temp_germination = ifelse(is.na(max_temp_germination),
                                       min_temp_germination,max_temp_germination),
         max_temp_grow = ifelse(is.na(max_temp_grow)|max_temp_grow=="",min_temp_grow,max_temp_grow)) |> 
  filter(cultivation!="Miscellaneous") |> 
  mutate(cultivation = ifelse(cultivation=="Solanum","Solanaceae",cultivation)) |> 
  group_by(cultivation) |> 
  summarise(ave_min_temp_grow = mean(as.numeric(min_temp_grow)),
            ave_max_temp_grow = mean(as.numeric(max_temp_grow)),
            ave_min_temp_germ = mean(as.numeric(min_temp_germination)),
            ave_max_temp_germ = mean(as.numeric(max_temp_germination)),
            range_temp_grow = ave_max_temp_grow - ave_min_temp_grow,
            range_temp_germ = ave_max_temp_germ - ave_min_temp_germ,
            sample_size = n()
            ) |> 
  mutate(id = row_number())


```

### Plot

```{r}

sb <- glue("Showing range <span style='color:{primary} font-weight:\"bold\";'>Grow Temperature</span>
           and <span style='color:{secondary};'> Germ Temperature</span>
           ")


y_axis_labels = unique(cleaned_data$cultivation)
y_axis_id = unique(cleaned_data$id)


cleaned_data |>  
  ggplot()+
  geom_segment(aes(x=ave_min_temp_grow,
                   xend = ave_max_temp_grow,
                   y=id),
               linewidth = 4,
               lineend = "round",
               colour = primary,
               alpha = 0.4)+
    geom_segment(aes(x=ave_min_temp_germ,
                   xend = ave_max_temp_germ,
                   y=id),
                 linewidth = 4,
                 lineend = "round",
               colour = secondary,alpha = 0.7)+
  geom_point(aes(x=ave_min_temp_grow,
                 y=id),
             fill = "#2a9d8f",
             size = 2)+
  labs(title = "Temperature ranges for different edible plant groups",
        subtitle = sb,
       caption = caption)+
  scale_y_continuous(labels = y_axis_labels,breaks = seq(1,7,1))+
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0,45,5),
                     labels = paste( seq(0,45,5),"\u00B0","C",sep = ""),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0.2,0.2)))+
  theme_minimal(base_family = f1)+
  theme(plot.caption = element_markdown(
    size=rel(0.6),
    lineheight = 1.5,
    hjust = 0,
    margin = margin(t=20,b=10)),
    plot.subtitle = element_markdown(margin = margin(t=10,b=10),lineheight = 1.3,hjust = 0,size = rel(0.8)),
    plot.margin = margin(25,25,25,25),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0,size=rel(0.9)),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill="#fefae0",colour = "#fefae0"),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill="#fefae0",colour = "#fefae0"),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank()
    
    )



```
